scope: Single repository/ref, explicit source-visible authorization operation; source skills are members, target repositories are inputs, and repeated task states are neither new skills nor new families.

families.readDepth: SKILL.md plus RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md and WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md at the same fixed ref; critical source passages independently checked against the original GitHub file
families.authorizationDuty: Trace a lower-trust principal and selected resource through the strongest visible validation or authorization control to a concrete effect; check that permission protects the correct target and alternate/bulk paths; distinguish source evidence from deployment facts.
families.actualInputForThisSlice: repo/ref, named operation, principal/resource relation, accepted policy and bounded source files; no target execution or deployment probe
families.methodImpact: Ask which object is checked versus changed, whether the strongest upstream control applies on the queried path, and which external facts are decisive.

families.readDepth: SKILL.md plus references/vuln-categories.md, language-patterns.md and report-format.md at fixed ref; primary authorization and self-check passages independently checked against the original GitHub file
families.authorizationDuty: Inspect missing authentication, BOLA/IDOR and privilege escalation, trace cross-file user input to effect, and self-check framework or middleware protections before retaining a finding.
families.actualInputForThisSlice: repo/ref, explicit authorization-sensitive path and accepted policy, with fixed source closure
families.methodImpact: Verify the path-specific upstream gate and applicable role or ownership exception before treating a local missing check as a failure.

nearCounterexamples.readDepth: SKILL.md and existing indexed task card; not a mapped AH member
nearCounterexamples.reasonExcluded: Base/head, changed invariant, blame/history, caller/tests and blast radius are required relations that a single-ref authorization obligation cannot preserve.

nearCounterexamples.readDepth: existing research classification only; original ref not reverified in AH
nearCounterexamples.reasonExcluded: Agent-skill supply-chain provenance and prompt/tool exfiltration are different objects from application principal/resource authorization.

limits: No claim that either complete skill has been translated or that two families establish ecosystem coverage; remaining duties stay with their source skill.
